title: Underdog
subtitle: The Other Other Brontë
author: Sarah Gordon
tagline: This is not a story about well-behaved women.
synopsis: Charlotte Brontë has a confession: one sister became an idol, another became known as the third. You know the one. No, not that one. The other, other one - Anne. A sharp, funny retelling of the Brontë sisters from the edges.
_running_time_status: Estimated total of 140 minutes including interval, derived from Anne-marie Greene's 9 September estimate of one hour per act plus the confirmed 20-minute interval. Recheck act estimates nearer dress; do not use this estimate as a countdown trigger.

writer.body: Sarah Gordon's plays include The Snow Queen, Becoming Hettie and Underdog. Her work retells familiar stories from the edges, finding the voices history sidelined.

director.quote: Everyone knows Wuthering Heights. Everyone knows Jane Eyre. This is a play about the Brontë sister you can't quite name — and about what her family did to make sure of that.

about_play.headline: The other, other Brontë
about_play.body: Charlotte has a confession. One sister became an idol, another became known as the third. Sarah Gordon retells the Brontë story from the edges - gothic, funny and sharply observed.

venue.headline: A volunteer-run theatre
venue.body: Over 450 productions since 1955 in a building that is over 140 years old. Run entirely by members - no paid employees, on stage or off.
venue.footline: Registered charity 1161430 • A volunteer-run theatre in Earlsdon, Coventry

volunteer.body: Actors, makers, technicians, front-of-house, bar and box office - every part of the Criterion is volunteer-run. New members are always welcome, no experience needed.
volunteer.footline: Speak to front-of-house, or email info@criteriontheatre.co.uk

bar.body: Stay for a drink and a conversation.

bar_spotlight.body: Beers, wines, soft drinks and snacks are being served now in the foyer bar.

criterion_charity.body: Your ticket supports a registered charity. Our members keep this theatre alive — maintaining the building and making each production possible.

thank_you.headline: Thank you for coming
thank_you.body: For making the journey to Earlsdon, and for giving your evening to Underdog. We hope you'll come back.

_content_warnings_status: Anne-marie Greene supplied the complete notice on 9 September 2026. Themes and age advice are answered. The wording retains 'strobe effects' for this review draft while Paul Harrison confirms strobe versus flashing lights.

content_warnings.headline: Content notice
content_warnings.detail: Explicit language; themes of grief and death; depictions of attempted suicide; haze and strobe effects; suitable for ages 14 and above. The Criterion advises caution but does not enforce an age limit.
